question: Are there travel fees?
answer: GTA travel is included. From 50 to 150 km outside Toronto it is $101.25, and from 150 to 300 km it is $201.25. Further than that, or anywhere abroad, I quote it for you with any flights and nights away charged at cost. No surprises.

question: Do you offer wedding videography?
answer: Yes. Film is available on wedding days. Every listed wedding price is for photography, and I quote the film separately for your day. Ask in your inquiry and I will send you the number.

question: Do you provide the outfits?
answer: No. You bring your own outfits, and the outfit counts in the packages are how many outfit changes we plan into your session. I help you decide what to wear during your free consultation, and the what to wear guide on my blog is a good starting point.

question: When is the best time to shoot?
answer: Golden hour, always. Early morning or late afternoon light is unmatched. Overcast days work beautifully too. I will guide you on timing.

question: Do you help pick a location?
answer: Yes. Light first, location second. One great spot can give you a dozen different looks. Check out my location guide for ideas.

question: Will you help us with posing?
answer: I prompt, not pose. Natural movements, real reactions. The photos end up looking and feeling like you.

question: What if it rains?
answer: I still shoot. Covered spots, indoor spaces, or your home. Rain photos can be stunning. If you need to reschedule, 48 hours notice is all I ask.

question: Is the engagement session really free?
answer: Yes. It's included when you book any 2026 or 2027 wedding collection with me, from The Essentials ($1,401.25) to The Complete Story ($3,801.25). Normally the session is $351.25 on its own.

question: Do we have to do the engagement session? What if we don't want one?
answer: It's optional. If you'd rather skip it, you can. I'd rather you have it because it makes your wedding day photos better, but the offer is yours to take or leave.

question: Can the engagement session happen outside Toronto?
answer: Inside the GTA, yes, at no extra cost. Outside the GTA, I charge travel at cost. Destination engagements we can talk through.

question: What if the engagement photos aren't a fit?
answer: Walk away. Your wedding retainer is fully refundable, and the engagement session is on me. The photos stay with me, and we part ways with no charge. The whole point of the tasting is to find out whether we're right for each other before the wedding day.

question: What should I wear for my headshot?
answer: Solid colours photograph best. Avoid busy patterns and large logos, and bring a second option so we have a backup on the day. I send a short what to wear guide once you book, so you show up knowing exactly what works.

question: Where do headshot sessions happen?
answer: On location, wherever suits you. Your office, your campus, or a spot in the city with great light. Travel within the GTA is included.

question: How fast will I get my headshots?
answer: Your full gallery lands within a few days. Once you pick your favourites, the retouched files follow within a week. If you need them sooner, 48-hour express delivery is available as an add-on.

question: How does the student discount work?
answer: Show a valid student ID when you book. The student rate applies to current students and to grads within a year of graduating.

question: Can you photograph our whole team?
answer: Yes. Team and office headshots are quoted per group, so everyone matches in light and framing. Get in touch with your headcount and location and I will put a number together.

question: How does a surprise proposal shoot work?
answer: I arrive before you do and set up well back with a long lens, so your partner never sees a photographer. The whole question is photographed from a distance while it happens. Once it lands I walk over and introduce myself, and the rest of the hour is a mini shoot with the two of you.

question: When do we get the proposal photos?
answer: Your Fujifilm film simulation photos arrive the next day, so you have something to send your family right away. The remaining photos follow fully edited, delivered in a private online gallery. You get around 80 photos in total.

question: Can you help us choose the spot?
answer: Yes, that is part of the package. Tell me the places you are considering and the time of day you have in mind, and I will tell you which one photographs best and where I can stand without being seen. If you have no spot yet, the location guide is a good place to start.

question: What happens right after the yes?
answer: We use the rest of the hour on the two of you while it is still sinking in. A short walk, a few quiet frames, whatever the spot gives us. It is all covered by the same hour and counts toward the same set of around 80 photos.

question: Do we need a permit to propose there?
answer: It depends on the spot. Many Toronto parks and public paths are fine for a short handheld session, while some locations need a City of Toronto commercial photography permit and others sit on private property that books shoots in advance for a fee. Indoor spaces are stricter than outdoor ones, and the Allan Gardens conservatory is a good example: free outside, permit required for an indoor shoot. I check the requirement for your spot when we plan it, and the Toronto photo permit page lists what is known for each location.
